newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's Oct 18 foreign reserves $8.15 bln.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's Oct 18 foreign reserves $8.15 bln.

text.p: Colombia's net foreign reserves stood at $8.15 billion as of October 18, the most recent date for which official figures are available, the central bank said.
It said the figure, which marked a $14.6 million increase over October 11, compared to the $8.38 billion Colombia held in net foreign reserves on October 20 of last year.
Net foreign reserves dropped by $171.5 million, or 2.1 percent, between December 30 and October 18, the central bank said.
